newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Optek spins off Thermo Vision unit.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Optek spins off Thermo Vision unit.

text.p: Thermo Optek Corp said Tuesday it will spin out its Thermo Vision subsidiary through a distribution of all of the outstanding capital stock of Thermo Vision in the form of a dividend to Thermo Optek shareholders.

The deal should be completed by the second quarter of 1997. The company said it will seek a ruling from the Internal Revenue Service to affirm that the proposal won't have any current tax effect on Thermo Optek or its shareholders.

"We feel that the fast-growing market segments addressed by Thermo Vision are best pursued by a separate entity with its own access to the capital markets," Earl Lewis, Thermo Optek president and chief executive stated.
Thermo Optek is a subsidiary of Thermo Instrument Systems Inc, a Thermo Electron Corp company.

Thermo Vision, based in Franklin, Massachusetts, develops Thermo Optek technologies into application-specific instruments and manufactures optical and photonic components, systems, and subassemblies. It is currently developing proprietary optical sensors based on its detector technology for use in filmless dental imaging, Thermo Optek said.
For the six months ended June 29 Thermo Vision had revenues of $14.2 million, Thermo Optek said.
